assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices
dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: uncontrolled movement of PSV-4110 during routine operation

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on PSV-4110 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically managing corrosion and thinning findings. PSV-4110 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during routine operation while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 15 January 2013 an incident occurred on PSV-4110 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during routine operation, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
